base_envelope_asa.structural_purpose: Weather-proof foundational base envelope. Sliced at high 260C extrusion heat over a 95C heated bed to minimize warping across large ASA hexagonal footprints. Elephant-ear convective siphons are left completely clear of support structures.

interlayer_armor_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: Impact-resistant auxetic armor web layer. Automatically forces a micro-step temperature drop down to 235C to prevent polymer chain degradation, ensuring highly elastic, high-rebound shock dampening.

optical_skin_pmma.structural_purpose: Angle-invariant micro-prism skin. Sliced at a dense 0.12mm step down with 0% print fan cooling to optimize transparency and remove refractive scattering boundaries. Hardcodes an explicit 0.15mm interfacial co-polymer tie-layer compression overlap to force maximum melt adhesion where the acrylic pins anchor directly into the foundational ASA base envelope slots.
